[EN] Tracking Down Jadan
[ES] Rastreando a Jadan
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Where did he get off to?

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Poor Jadan...
[ES] Pobre Jadan...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Of course."
[ES] "Por supuesto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Centurion Okon at the northern gate of Popolion.
[ES] Habla con el centurión Okon en la puerta norte de Popolion.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Kripa if he's seen Jadan.
[ES] Pregúntale a Kripa si ha visto a Jadan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Rest in peace, Jadan."
[ES] "Descansa en paz, Jadan."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Jadan.
[ES] Encuentra a Jadan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Straightaway."
[ES] "De inmediato."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Kripa you found the messenger.
[ES] Dile a Kripa que encontraste al mensajero.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I wish I knew."
[ES] "Ojalá lo supiera."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Paka.
[ES] Informa a Paka.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
